I've been a delighted customer of Rasoi Ghar - Homemade Happiness, and I can't help but share my positive experience with this exceptional tiffin service.

From the very first bite, it was evident that the emphasis on quality and taste is at the core of what they do. The variety in their daily menus is truly impressive.

The deliveries are always punctual. It's evident that they take great care in ensuring that the food arrives in perfect condition.

They are responsive, friendly, and always willing to accommodate special requests or dietary restrictions. It's reassuring to know that they value open communication and are dedicated to making the dining experience enjoyable for their customers.

Rasoi Ghar - Homemade Happiness has exceeded my expectations on every front. If you're looking for a tiffin service that combines exceptional taste, variety, and customer care, I wholeheartedly recommend giving Rasoi Ghar - Homemade Happiness a try. It's a decision you won't regret!

featured_reviews.name: Derrick D'Souza
featured_reviews.review_text:
After my wife's inability to cook due to orthopaedic issues, I was scanning the mobile for some outside caterer to fill in the void. And my eyes happened to see the food app " Tiffinkart " which instaneously caught my attention. I was not on the wrong track when I made my choice and both of us, decided to try out this catering avenue.
I got in touch with Mrs Sharmila and after a brief discussion about the rates and menu to go with, hit on her Tiffinkart app to get her to deliver food for us at our residence.
On the very first day of receiving her tiffin (one veg, the other non veg) we were delighted to see such mouth watering fare, vis-a-vis the price attached to it. oHer food is very tasty, and delicious and easily digestable. This Lady is very accommodating, kind, gentle and understanding towards the need of the hour.
However, my interaction with her made me feel like she is a family member. This is an added quality to the food she serves. No wonder a clientele stretches from Churchgate to Virar as far as I know.
Its amazing how this young, charming lady can meet the needs of those in need of good food to feed themselves.
My to all is that I have tried, tested and am still enjoying the meals coming from her gracious kitchen.

featured_reviews.name: Amit Arekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently tried Tiffinkart and was wowed by the quality of their food. Both the veg and non-veg options were flavorful and perfectly prepared. Each dish reflected great care and quality, arriving at the perfect temperature.

A special thanks to Shreeya, the owner, whose proactive approach added to the wonderful experience. Her attention to service and detail truly stands out, ensuring everything was just right.

For anyone seeking delicious and reliable meals, Tiffinkart is a fantastic choice. I highly recommend them for their exceptional food and service.
